doc.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021

title: Smooth jazz, new age and Jimi Hendrix
summary: He complains Sirius FM favors smooth jazz though they started new age music in the 70s; Rowe compares rock and roll, Smith praises Hendrix.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: On the Sirius FM now it’s the complete opposite as far as smooth jazz.
So you know we started it, what they call new age music, we were doing that back in the 70s. So you know.
Yeah. I’m afraid that’s happened a number of times before too, even with rock & roll.

Oh my goodness you’re right. That’s a good example. I mean in London they should have a statue, they should have knighted Jimi Hendrix, I mean Jimi Hendrix went to London that saved all those rock & roll groups that are making millions of dollars a day.
